routes.condition: Simple questions, short text editing, routine transformations, or tasks where low latency is not important. Prefer the local model when it is sufficient.
Summarization, reports, translation, or analysis of a long document, especially when Japanese fluency and context length matter more than deep reasoning.
Extract text from an image or PDF, read a screenshot, or understand visual content.
Complex planning, system design, nontrivial coding, debugging, or reasoning that requires several steps.
